notes: Vessel calls: live in-port positions observed via AIS (Open Waters / AISHub aggregate, ~1 min delayed), merged with public pilot/port-authority plans (Cảng vụ Hải Phòng port authority + Tan Cang Pilot); berth assignment, forward ETDs & TEU remain modelled estimates
TEU figures are model estimates from draft & port stay — not terminal-confirmed lifts
National trade totals are official (GDVC); province/commodity split is a demo model
Monthly national/region throughput is real VPA association data
ICD volumes & barge flows are corridor-model estimates (see Inland network notes)

ICD berth watch (Sotrans · SOWATCO Long Binh) & the SOWATCO fleet list are AIS-observed from geofences — berth slots indicative; the Long Binh geofence is approximate and free-AIS coverage on that reach is limited
AIS data credit: AISHub contributors (aishub.net) via Open Waters AIS (openwaters.io) — source terms require this attribution
Pilot/port-authority plans publish ~24–36h ahead — empty berths beyond that horizon are unplanned, not necessarily idle

Berth layouts for the Dinh Vu-area terminals (Nam Dinh Vu, Nam Hai Dinh Vu, VIMC Dinh Vu, VIP Greenport, Tan Vu, Hai An, Nam Hai), Tan Cang Hiep Phuoc, SP-ITC and Gemalink are indicative — depths from operator/VPA publications, but per-berth splits are not public
Port-stay predictions learn from AIS-observed stay history (per vessel, then class-at-port, then class default) — basis shown per call
TEU calibration: inactive until ≥10 days of observed daily history exist per port — shown TEU are raw draft×stay model estimates
